title: Lab - Pods
description: Create, inspect and repair Pods from the command line and from manifests.
scenario: Create, inspect and repair Pods from the command line and from manifests. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create a Pod imperatively
tasks.instructions: Run an nginx Pod named web in the default namespace.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Write a Pod manifest
tasks.instructions: Generate a manifest for a redis Pod without creating it, save it, then apply it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl run cache --image=redis --dry-run=client -o yaml > cache.yaml
kubectl apply -f cache.yaml

tasks.title: Task 3 - Diagnose a broken image
tasks.instructions: Create a Pod with image nginx:doesnotexist and explain why it is not Running.
tasks.solution:
kubectl run broken --image=nginx:doesnotexist
kubectl describe pod broken | tail -20
tasks.verification: kubectl get pod broken  # STATUS ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull
